title: Chapter 754
text:
Two figures, one white and one blue, collided with each other like comets!

Boom!

The energy shockwave from the collision sent the mechanical soldiers around flying!

Psionic energy gushed out of his body continuously. Han Xiao's fists landed heavily on Sisko's psychic shield, and a loud buzzing sound rang out. Without retracting his fists, the armor on his arm transformed into a huge hand cannon. The black muzzle of the cannon lit up with a burning red light.

Boom!

Violent dark energy annihilation rays poured out, and the light beam washed over Sisko, who was as still as a rock.

This guy's psychic defense is too strong. The value of his shield is high, and new shields will be generated after it is broken. Although he is not immune to True Damage, the premise is that the attacks hit him. Han Xiao frowned.

A psychic's psychic shield was the same as a mage's magic shield, and it was even stronger in some aspects. The psychic shield had double resistance, and it could be adjusted according to Sisko's will. Because Han Xiao was a physical attacker, he reduced the psychic resistance of the psychic shield by ninety percent and merged it with the physical resistance, resulting in the shield being very tough.

Luckily, Sisko's physique was not his forte, and he did not have True Damage Immunity. Han Xiao could also trigger True Damage on the psychic shield and deal high damage. However, hitting the shield did not mean hitting Sisko's body.

The psychic class was quite effective against him, so the most direct way to deal with it was to cover him with firepower.

Rumble —

The Mech Legion had spread out in formation and covered the sky as if there was no end to them. They flew around Sisko like a tornado. Psionic Particle Cannons, Dark Energy Annihilation Cannons, Plasma Powered Cannons, and other weapons were all focused on Sisko.

Dozens of satellite cannons, including the Ice Age Star Freezing Cannon, flew into the sky. The next moment, thick ion beams descended from outer space and smashed onto Sisko's shield like spears.

At this time, Sisko suddenly opened all four of his arms. White Psychokinesis gathered like a whirlpool and then suddenly exploded. The Psychokinesis produced a huge repulsive force that sent Han Xiao flying.

The Psychokinetic Impact Ring swept past the mechanical soldiers that were too close. These mechanical soldiers were smashed into pieces as if they had been hit by meteorites.

Then, Sisko bent his knees slightly and assumed a jumping posture, as if the air was the ground.

Bang!

He kicked off with both legs and launched himself into the air, creating sonic booms as he charged into the midst of the Mech Legion.

The psychokinesis that enveloped his body began to spin at high speed. His entire body seemed to have turned into a drill, charging back and forth within the Mech Legion. He was unstoppable. As he charged, he released shockwaves of Psychic Energy into the distance. There were at least a hundred of them each time.

The formation of the Mech Legion was torn apart by Sisko. Countless broken parts fell like rain. The number of mechanical soldiers lost quickly climbed to hundreds of thousands.

The two sides continued to fight. The battlefield moved rapidly on the surface of the planet. Everywhere they passed, the ground was covered by the firepower of the Mech Legion. The aftershock blasted into rifts and sinkholes. The height of the ground dropped by thousands of meters. It was as if a rock layer had been shaved off, causing the crust to become thinner.

Han Xiao kept chasing after Sisko to engage in close combat. Sisko did not bother with him at all. He only focused on killing the Mech Legion. As long as Han Xiao got close, he would use his Psychic Energy to push him away.

He was extremely fast, and his shield was thick. Many of the focused attacks were dodged by him, but some of the attacks still hit him.

The combat information showed some of Sisko's attributes. His level was a question mark, but his HP was not as high as Han Xiao's. He only had around 2,200,000 HP. At this time, he had lost more than 100,000 HP and was slowly recovering. He recovered about 10,000 HP per second. His normal recovery rate was about 0.5%, but because his maximum HP was high, the actual recovery rate was not low either.

While fighting, Han Xiao glanced at the interface and thought to himself, His Beyond Grade A talent didn't add Eternal Body. He should have added Supreme Power and a talent related to energy.

Energy was the foundation of the Psychic class. Psychics used up a lot of energy, but Sisko's energy was almost endless.

Seeing that the Mech Legion's casualties were close to a million, Han Xiao waved his hand. His Mechanical Force stuck to the broken parts in the sky like spider silk and assembled them together. He directly used [Waste Modification] and [Basic Machinery Construction] to pull up most of the broken mechanical soldiers and threw them back to the battlefield.

At this time, the Mech Legion was relatively fragile, but he had all kinds of methods to recover the army, so they would not be easily wiped out. However, his expression was not relaxed.

This guy saw that I did not update the Mech Legion and used my army as a breakthrough point. His energy recovery is too fast, and it will be difficult to fight a battle of attrition.

He had taken more than 100,000 HP from Sisko, but he had lost around 600,000 to 700,000 HP. While Sisko was killing the Mech Legion, he would turn around and throw Psychic Blast or Psychic Pierce at him from time to time. Even though Sisko was cursed with luck, and the frequency of critical hits was obviously lower, his normal damage was still very high.

Mechanics lacked mental defense methods and were countered by Psychics. The psychic attacks used by the opponent were like directional skills, and he could not dodge them at all.

However, he had already recovered his HP to full.

[Medium Effect Cell Proliferation Control] converted energy into HP at a ratio of 1: 5. Due to the upper limit of his energy, he could only recover about 25 HP per second. Although the psychic attacks would not give him mana, he could control the Watcher Protocol floating cannons around him to continuously attack him, which also had the effect of recovering mana.

If this continues, I will be very passive. I can't let him attack my army so recklessly.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. He raised his hand, and a mechanical device appeared beside him. This was a high-level mechanical control trap — Electric Arc Traction Reaction Base. Its purpose was to control the target with a strong magnetic force.

A golden Mechanical Force surged out from his palm and hit the Electric Arc Traction Reaction Base. This special Mechanical Force merged with it and wrapped around the mechanical structure. On the interface, the performance of this mechanical device instantly skyrocketed. This golden Mechanical Force had given it a special buff.

Emperor's Gift!

The next moment, the Electric Arc Traction Reaction Base was activated. Dozens of lightning bolts as thick as pythons exploded in the center of the base, and a strong magnetic force was released toward Sisko.

Hum!

Sisko, who was flying at high speed in the distance, suddenly stopped in midair. It was as if an invisible hand had grabbed his tail.

Without the buff from Emperor's Gift, the Electric Arc Traction Reaction Base alone would not have been able to catch Sisko.

The control time was very short, and Han Xiao directly escaped into the Void Dimension. The next moment, he appeared behind Sisko and grabbed onto Sisko's arm.

The Mountain Ape mechanical suit changed shape, and nanoparticles climbed onto Sisko's body, turning into strong shackles that firmly held onto him.

Sizzle …

Han Xiao directly activated [Gene Liberation], and the entire army received a critical hit.

The next moment, all the Mech Army opened fire toward the two of them!

Heaven and Earth Live!

Boom! Boom!

The explosion created a shockwave thousands of kilometers away. Another energy ball was created on the ground, and a new crater was left on the planet.

Han Xiao was blasted far away. He tumbled a few hundred kilometers in the air before stabilizing himself. He immediately recovered his health and looked around for Sisko.

He saw that Sisko's main body was also blasted far away, and his condition was not good.

At this time, Sisko's body was covered in burn marks. He had just been disturbed by Han Xiao, and his psychic shield was not able to block all the power of the explosion. It just happened to trigger True Damage, and he lost a small amount of health. However, he had all kinds of psychic talents, so he was immune to negative statuses like Dizziness. He would not be unable to move after being severely injured.

At this time, Han Xiao suddenly felt a piercing sense of danger behind his head.

He hurriedly turned around and cast a psionic shield. He saw a white figure that seemed to be condensed from fog suddenly appear behind him. The shield did not seem to exist, and the figure directly rushed into Han Xiao's body.

Hum!

Han Xiao could clearly feel that the white figure had directly rushed into his spiritual body's brain, wreaking havoc inside, and finally detonating himself, severely injuring his spirit. His brain was in so much pain that it felt like it was being smashed into paste.

Sisko's skill took out nearly two hundred thousand of his health. Han Xiao's mouth and nose were bleeding. He hurriedly retreated, but he heard Sisko also let out a muffled groan.

Enduring the pain of his brain being smashed, Han Xiao followed the sound and found that Sisko was also bleeding from many orifices, just like himself.

"This is … right!" Han Xiao hurriedly looked at the combat information and almost laughed out loud.

Sisko's sneak attack just happened to trigger [Supreme Piety]'s 20% chance of spiritual damage reflection, and Sisko took the reflected damage.

His luck was low, but Sisko was cursed with luck, so his luck was not much better.

"I don't know if I'm lucky or he's unlucky …"

This time, Sisko suddenly raised his head, and blood splattered everywhere. His six secondary eyes lit up, forming an incandescent ring on his face. The center of the ring was his main eye.

Then, his appearance changed again. This time, bone armor spread on the surface of his body, covering his entire body, and only his seven eyes could be seen.

The combat information showed that Sisko had entered a new state, and all his attributes had increased tremendously. At the same time, a layer of fake white blood appeared on his health bar, which was a full sixty percent of his maximum health, increasing his health by more than one million and three hundred thousand.

"Again," Sisko said concisely. His voice was deep and deep, like the reverberating sound of a bell.

Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and he felt a toothache.

SEED BURST again?

Are you f * cking Frieza?

Do you think you can do whatever you want just because you're a combat race? That's against the rules!

"Beyond Grade As are indeed perverted. They have endless means." Han Xiao felt a headache coming on.

Although Sisko did not have recovery means like him, he had different transformation states and various psychic abilities to provide himself with fake health and shields.

Back then, he had been invincible in the Calamity Grade, and his ability was close to a bug. However, in the Beyond Grade A realm, everyone was a bug.

"Hiss!"

Taking a deep breath, Han Xiao pushed the energy in his body to a new peak. With a low roar, he led the Mech Legion and clashed with Sisko again!

After the previous exchange, Han Xiao had a judgment of the combat strength of both sides. Overall, they were evenly matched. It would be difficult for him to kill Sisko, and Sisko would not be able to kill him. However, as the number of the Mech Legion decreased, his damage output would continue to decrease.

Since the Mech Legion was going to be rebuilt, Han Xiao decided to ignore the casualties and seize this rare opportunity to test his combat strength. Only in a battle between Beyond Grade As would he have the chance to go all out.

Boom boom boom!

The two of them fought for a few hours, flying around the planet countless times. The surface of the planet was destroyed by the aftershocks.

Many bottomless holes had been dug out on the surface of the planet. The intense crustal movement had pumped the high-temperature magma in the mantle out of these holes and spurted thousands of meters into the sky. The planet seemed to have turned into an orange that had been pierced with many small holes and then squeezed hard to spurt out orange juice.

The magma that was spurted out quickly cooled down and solidified into a semi-solid state as if it was raining meteorites.

Boom!

The two of them clashed for the millionth time before bouncing off each other.

Han Xiao hovered in midair. The mechanical suit on the surface of his body shattered and completely disintegrated, revealing his original body. This was already his fourth mechanical suit. [Machinery Continuation] had reached its time limit, and the mechanical suit shattered into a pile of useless parts.

The Mech Legion in all directions had become much sparser. Han Xiao had used the Waste Modification many times and had long reached the limit of repair. Even so, the Mech Legion was only left with about four million.

On the other side, more than half of Sisko's bone armor had shattered, and his body was covered in blue blood. His psychic energy had become much thinner.

"More than half of the Mech Legion has been lost. If this continues, I'll be forced into a passive state …" Han Xiao thought to himself.

He can't do anything to me, and I can't do anything to him either. There's no need to waste any more time. I'll just go back and build a new Mech Legion first …

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he threw an Observer's Mark at Sisko.

The psychic locator that Sisko had left in the Evolution Cube could not be removed. He could only return the favor and mark the two of them together. Only then would he not be at a disadvantage.

"Hmm?" Sisko's eyes narrowed. With his sharp senses, he could feel that he was being watched, but he did not know where it came from.

He was not a Mage who could control multi-dimensional energy. Although he could feel the Observer's Mark, he could not remove it.

Furthermore, Han Xiao had reached the Beyond Grade A level, so it would be even harder to remove the Observer's Mark. At the very least, a Calamity Grade Mage would not be able to do so.

Clank!

At this time, Han Xiao waved his hand and recalled the Mech Legion. Without saying anything, he activated Void Dimension Hyperdrive and disappeared in the blink of an eye.

During the battle, he had intentionally destroyed the other party's spaceship. With the speed of Sisko's physical body, it would be impossible for him to catch up to him.

Sisko watched as Han Xiao disappeared. He did not move, and his heart was heavy.

He had already given it his all, but Black Star was not at a disadvantage. With him alone, he would not be able to snatch the Evolution Cube back …

Not only did Han Xiao think that neither of them could do anything to the other, but Sisko also felt the same.

He could not count how many times he had dealt mental damage to Black Star, but only the Mech Legion had suffered significant losses. Black Star himself was still alive and kicking.

This situation reminded him of the Tyrant.

"A new Beyond Grade A Mechanic with a body as strong as the Tyrant's."

Sisko mumbled to himself, "Indestructible Body …"

At this time, a figure flew over. It was Sardeem. His appearance was extremely haggard, and he was wearing a simple rocket thruster modified from discarded parts. He flew very slowly.

"You're still alive?" Sisko could not help but look over.

"That was close. When you guys were fighting, I hid."

Sardeem still had some lingering fear. He did not have any equipment on him, and the shockwaves from the battle between two Beyond Grade As were enough to threaten his life. Thus, he had long escaped from Sisko's spaceship, left the battlefield, and found a place to hide.

Looking at Sisko's appearance, Sardeem opened his mouth. He could not help but ask with a trembling voice, "You … didn't manage to defeat Black Star?"

Sisko glanced at him and said, "He ran away. I couldn't stop him."

Sardeem held his breath. He had already expected this and only wanted to confirm it personally. However, even though he was mentally prepared, he was still shocked.

"The birth of the fifth Beyond Grade A in the Shattered Star Ring. The situation of the Star Field is going to change again." Sardeem swallowed his saliva and said, "I have to pass this information to His Excellency Manison."

"Not only the Shattered Star Ring …" Sisko interrupted him with a strange tone. "The attention of the entire galaxy might be attracted by him."

The Evolution Cube was not that easy to obtain.

Sisko's eyes sparkled.

Black Star carried the Evolution Cube with him everywhere, so it would be difficult for him to snatch it back alone. Sisko decided to work with some allies and plan for the long term.

Before this, the Evolution Cube would be temporarily stored with Black Star. Since the psychic positioning was still there, Sisko felt that things were still under control.

Looking up at the deep starry sky, Sisko did not plan to fly with his physical body. He turned around and looked at Sardeem.

"You're a Mechanic, right?"

"Er, what's wrong?" Sardeem was stunned.

Sisko pointed at the discarded parts scattered on the ground.

"Build a spaceship."

"…" Sardeem.
